message: These files no longer hold rates. All central bank, tax and customs authority tables are now served to registered users only. Create a free AllRatesToday account (one minute, no card) at https://allratestoday.com/register/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=moved_notice&utm_campaign=central-bank-exchange-rates, copy the API key from your dashboard, then call https://allratestoday.com/api/v1/central-bank/<code>/latest with the header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY'. The list of codes is at https://allratestoday.com/central-bank-rates-api/institutions/.
history: Full history back to 1914, one CSV per institution: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AllRatesToday/central-bank-exchange-rates (log in to Hugging Face and paste your free AllRatesToday key into the Get access form; approved within about 5 minutes).
why: We need to know who relies on the data so we can support it, tell users about source changes and outages, and keep it free.
